text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Finance Minister Antonio de Sousa Franco sets up working group to review legislation on public accounting, suggesting change on the dates for the preparation of state budget.
- Investment banks boosted profits in 1996 due to favourable situation of Portuguese economy. This scenario may be maintanined this year altough at a slower pace.
- Comercial associations of Portugal and Canada signed a cooperation agreement which may have advantages for both countries due to NAFTA on the one side and single market on the other.
- Portuguese economy evolved positively in March, according to National Statistics Institute survey. The building sector was the most dynamic.

- Airlines KLM, Swissair, Air France, Finnair and Aer Lingus state would not be interested in strategic alliance with Portuguese state airline TAP if its working practices not changed, TAP chairman Ferreira Lima says.
